Method of Attack: Malicious code in preinstall scripts triggers download and execution of remote malicious scripts during package installation
Downloads and runs a mining service executable named 'jsextension' from a remote IP
On Windows, additionally downloads a trojan component
Modification of package.json scripts field to execute malicious preinstall.js, preinstall.bat, and prenstall.sh
Impacted Systems: Node.js ecosystem packages depending on ua-parser-js
Approximately 780 packages with 17087 versions directly dependent on ua-parser-js@0.7.28
Up to 110750 versions including indirect dependencies
Attack Vector: Compromise of maintainer account (password leak or brute force) to publish malicious versions
Supply chain attack via npm package repository
